title: Talk:Potion Mule
html:
A sidelight to the Potion Mule page:

The small fly in the ointment is that DaMule does not get paid as much for the Yellow and Purple items as DaBigGuy would. This would seem to spoil the scheme.

However, in my experiende, DaMule can buy potions for 25 gp while DaBigGuy pays 400 or more ... at least 16 times as much. But DaMule can sell purples for about 1/4 what DaBigGuy can. So there is still a mathematical advantage of at least 4x in the deal.

--Catwalksbyhimself 16:18, 15 March 2008 (CET)
